name: 78589 · San Juan, TX
findings: ZIP 78589 (San Juan) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (19%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78589 (San Juan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
